page_title: LinkUnbound: browser picker for Windows and macOS

sources.entry: LinkUnbound - Open-source browser picker that asks which browser or browser profile should open each link, with rules by site or by the app the link came from. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/rgdevment/LinkUnbound) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: LinkUnbound
summary.one_liner: LinkUnbound is a free, open source browser picker for Windows and macOS that becomes the default browser and asks which browser or profile should open each link.
use_cases: Send Teams or Slack links to a chosen browser instead of Edge
Route links to a specific Chrome profile such as work or personal
Pick a browser for each link with a small popup
Set rules by website or by the app a link came from
Avoid Microsoft SafeLinks redirects breaking rule matching
summary.what_it_does: LinkUnbound registers itself as the default browser so links clicked outside a browser pass through it first. If a rule matches the link (by site, browser profile, or the originating application), it opens immediately in the target browser. If no rule matches, a small picker appears beside the cursor where the user chooses a browser using the mouse or keys 1 to 9. Installed browsers and Chromium profiles are detected automatically, and Microsoft SafeLinks are unwrapped before rules are matched. The page states that rules and opened links stay on the local machine, with no account, ads, or telemetry.
notable: Rules can match by site, browser profile, or the source application (e.g. all Teams links to one browser)
Unwraps Microsoft SafeLinks before rule matching
Installable via Homebrew cask or winget; released under GPL-3.0-only
No account, no telemetry; rules stay on the machine
caveats: Microsoft Teams and classic Outlook have their own settings that must be changed first, and some Microsoft links still go straight to Edge on Windows 11
Page lists no paid tier; no other limitations are stated
